rationale: Acceptance criteria for Assistants parity all pass (embedded yaml_config_history, client Restore, no versions/rollback API). One major regression remains: Restore does not clear an active AI-refine snapshot, so Revert to Previous can overwrite restored YAML. Other lens items were dismissed as spec-intentional (no confirm, editor toast copy matching Assistants, dirty tracking via replaceYamlConfig/blockTransition) or deferred (null yaml_config on a typed-required string, route-id change while popup open). Official vs-main diff was large because of prior branch work; this-run src delta was fully reviewed. Dismissed 17, deferred 3.

findings.title: Restore does not clear AI refine snapshot
findings.problem: handleRestoreFromHistory writes history YAML into the editor but leaves preRefinementYaml set. The previous server-rollback path called setPreRefinementYaml(null).
findings.impact: After Refine with AI then Restore from history, Revert to Previous overwrites the restored YAML with the pre-refinement snapshot.
findings.recommendation: Call setPreRefinementYaml(null) inside handleRestoreFromHistory, matching the old rollback success path.
